pages: Section 4.1. The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio as of any fiscal quarter end to exceed 3.50:1.00.
Section 1.1 Definitions. Total Leverage Ratio means Total Debt divided by EBITDA.

Amendment No. 1 — Section 2. The parties amend Section 4.1 by replacing '3.50:1.00' with '4.00:1.00'. The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio as of any fiscal quarter end to exceed 4.00:1.00.
Section 1.1 Definitions. Total Leverage Ratio means Total Debt divided by EBITDA.
